blocks.x: Yeah, but I was a Christian after, in 1935 at the Holy Ghost. Oh, did you know sales up the country? In Donalvilleville? No, no, I met, I met, I met Manuel Sells playing with Sidney Desmond. Manuel Sells at this time was living up here. Yeah. He always did live up here.
Uptown? Uptown. Yeah. He told me his family's from Donalvilleville. His sister, that's what he told me too.

I don't remember, I don't remember that. His sister was a good friend of mine, Rosalie, she's dead now. Now I don't know the brother that's the priest, but I know Pete. I know Pete before I know Manuel. Pete was playing banjo with Clyde, with no, with the Brown Buddies band. And then he joined Clyde Coors band. And I come in there after Morgan. And then Pete Morgan came in, Eddie Morgan came in playing the band, the guitar with Clyde, after Pete. Yeah. And then I came after Eddie Morgan. But Pete Sales, you didn't know Pete Sales. Never met him. He was nice, nice, nice and resistant, but he was a painter now. He painted in the water when I was in the child hospital and I talked with him.
